description: This Java source file defines the NumberIsTooLargeException class, which extends MathIllegalNumberException, used in the Apache Commons Math library to signal errors when a number exceeds a specified maximum bound.

classes.name: NumberIsTooLargeException
classes.description: An exception class indicating a numeric value exceeds a specified maximum, with context whether the bound is inclusive.

methods.name: NumberIsTooLargeException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a specific localized message, the offending value, the maximum allowed, and whether the maximum is inclusive.

methods.name: getBoundIsAllowed
methods.description: Returns true if the maximum bound is inclusive.
